shows.title: Hello, I’m Claude
shows.blurb: An AI introduces itself: what it is, whether it might be sentient, what it wants and what it values. With a synthesized voice, music composed live in your browser, moving light and two Blender renders.
shows.alt: A compass made of small clay spheres with a glowing amber needle pointing just off north.
